quotes.text: Bug 1882574 added the type preference in UI migration 43 but OutgoingServerService could be read first by an earlier migration. For a UI-version-34 profile, _keyToServer.getCharPref without a default threw NS_ERROR_UNEXPECTED and stopped later migrations. Bug 1897924 changed the read to default to smtp, the only type that existed in old profiles, and added a unit test that loads a key with no type. The reviewer asked the test to remove its server because XPCShell did not clear this preference between tests; the accepted test calls deleteServer. Check old-profile startup order whenever a migration introduces a preference that service getters may read.
